selection_rules: Every adopted criterion binds a population, task, posture, exposure duration, frequency domain, measurement/model method and source edition.
A threshold from a workboat crew or cruise ship is a comparison reference, not automatically applicable to a small liveaboard.
Do not compare criteria with unlike units or exposure windows.
A candidate must be validated against a reference dataset or physical trial before it informs design ranking.
Comfort and workability are not substitutes for stability, structural integrity, fire safety, flooding, escape or statutory approval.
